card.name: Key words in label warnings and references
card.fires_on: The word right after 'This product' (contains), after 'See Full Prescribing Information for' (important), and 'calcium' in supplementation advice. Fires in label headings and warning statements.

modes.label: Product contains warning
modes.description: The verb 'contains' after 'This product' in a caution about an ingredient.
modes.example: Warning: This product<< contains>> aluminum that may be toxic.

modes.label: See prescribing information for important
modes.description: 'important' or 'information' in the cross-reference to full prescribing information on administration.
modes.example: See Full Prescribing Information for<< important>> administration instructions (2.1) Maximum

modes.label: Supplemental calcium
modes.description: 'calcium' after 'supplemental' or 'with' in calcium and vitamin D advice.
